home.hero.subtitle: An interactive online program designed specifically for non-Arabic-speaking children. Build a strong foundation in Arabic language and Quranic reading through structured, age-appropriate lessons.
home.mission.title: Our Mission
home.mission.text: We believe every child, regardless of background, deserves access to high-quality Arabic and Quranic education. Our mission is to bridge the gap for non-Arabic-speaking families worldwide, offering a nurturing, structured, and joyful path to language and spiritual connection.
home.benefits.title: Everything your child needs to succeed
home.benefits.subtitle: We combine expert teaching with a joyful, child-centered approach to make Arabic and Quranic education effective and enjoyable.
home.benefits.fun.title: Fun & Interactive Lessons
home.benefits.fun.desc: Engaging activities, games, and exercises designed to keep children motivated and enjoying every step of their learning journey.
home.benefits.structured.title: Structured Levels
home.benefits.structured.desc: 8 progressive Arabic levels and 2 Quran levels ensure clear milestones. Children build skills step by step, from letters to full sentences.
home.benefits.teachers.title: Qualified Teachers
home.benefits.teachers.desc: All instructors are experienced Arabic and Quran teachers who specialise in working with non-native-speaking children.
home.benefits.beginners.title: Designed for Beginners
home.benefits.beginners.desc: No prior Arabic knowledge needed. We start from the very basics — the Arabic alphabet — so every child can succeed.
home.benefits.anywhere.title: Learn from Anywhere
home.benefits.anywhere.desc: 100% online classes accessible from any device. Study from home, at any time that fits your family's schedule.
home.benefits.safe.title: Safe & Trusted Environment
home.benefits.safe.desc: Parent-approved content, verified teachers, and a child-safe platform parents and guardians can fully trust.
home.trust.title: Trusted by families worldwide
home.trust.q1: My daughter went from zero Arabic to reading simple Quran verses in just 3 months. The teachers are incredibly patient.
home.trust.q2: We live in Canada and had no Arabic resources nearby. AQ Academy has been a lifeline for our son's Islamic education.
home.trust.q3: The structured levels make it easy to track progress. Our 7-year-old actually asks for his Arabic class — that says everything!
home.cta.title: Ready to begin the journey?
home.cta.subtitle: Join hundreds of families giving their children the gift of Arabic and Quran — from the comfort of home.
